name: Cozbi
bio: Cozbi was the daughter of Zur, a leader of a Midianite clan. When Israel fell under a plague from God for committing sexual immorality with Moabite women and worshiping Baal of Peor, Zimri, a leader of the tribe of Simeon, brazenly brought her into his own tent in full view of Moses and the whole assembly; Phinehas, seeing this, took a spear and ran them both through, and the plague was stopped (Numbers 25:6-8, 15, 18).
